_: The crown's money, one place (treasury.js reads it). start: the King's purse at his crowning, in gold, by the reign's wealth. tithe.perSize: what a great house's towns yield the crown a year per size point at a tithe of 1 (a quarter each season; at the usual 0.1 the realm's ~125 sizes bring about 75 a season). tithe.housePays: the most a house hands over from its own purse in a season, as a share of it (the rest is taken at the town gates). wear: each time the King buys the same thing within wear.seasons, its price rises by wear.step of the base. upkeepShare: what a great treasury costs the crown each season (stewards, gifts, loans called in), as a share of it, so an idle purse levels off. thin: below this the treasury is thin (one big thing's worth) and the court may hear of it.
